tagline: Happy 20th Birthday to the Love of My Life
heroMessage:
Today marks your 20th birthday — and the world is infinitely more radiant because you are in it. From your graceful smile to that enchanting look in your red and black sari, every single moment with you is pure magic.

May this year unfold with boundless joy, thrilling milestones, and every dream your heart has ever held.

Here's to celebrating you on your special day and forever.

secretMessage.title: A Secret Letter From Your Hubby ❤️
secretMessage.subtitle: Only for my real Arpi • 13th November
secretMessage.content:
My Sweetest Arpi,

Happy 20th Birthday, my love!

From that very first day we met at Chunkutia with me in that white shirt, to that magical first kiss at Rajendrapur, every memory with you has been etched forever into my heart.

You look so breathtaking in that red and black sari, but even more beautiful is the warmth, laughter, and kindness you bring into my world every single day.

Thank you for choosing me, for believing in us, and for being my greatest blessing. On this milestone 20th birthday, I promise to hold your hand, stand by your side through every storm and sunshine, and love you more and more with each passing breath.

Forever & always yours,
Anik (Your Hubby) ❤️
